# High Baseline Gap Dispositions

For a brownfield rewrite, treat high baseline gaps as explicit mitigation contracts and completion gates rather than accepted risks or vague cautions.

## What Happened

In Space-Mission-Design-Game task t2.1, five HIGH baseline findings were triaged against approved outcomes: gameplay fidelity, consent-only save import, iframe removal, verification, and mobile controls. The approved rewrite made each mandatory; none could be waived. Each disposition was expressed as baseline evidence, rationale, mitigation contract, exit evidence, and residual risk.

## Takeaway

Keep dispositions anchored to upstream evidence and user-approved constraints. Define observable gates that downstream implementers and testers can prove. Do not invent target API details while triaging, and separate fixed requirements from unresolved residuals (such as an absent performance baseline).
